# Saibaba Vemuri (Sai)

Senior Solutions Architect – Head of Data Science

Saibaba Vemuri has over 10+ years of experience across Banking, Financial Services, Insurance, Retail, E-commerce, Telecom, Oil & Gas, and Airline domains. Demonstrated expertise in delivering scalable analytics solutions, deploying ML/AI models, and driving strategic insights across Fraud, Risk, Customer Support, and Remediation domains. Proven track record of enhancing operational efficiency, customer experience, and data-driven decision-making
